fixtures.name: Robot vacuum
fixtures.alt: A white round robot vacuum cleaner on a gray area rug in front of a cream sofa and a black geometric wire side table.
fixtures.exampleIssue: It stops, then jerks backward once.

procedure.title: Start a first cleaning run on a flat floor
steps: Place the vacuum on a flat, clear floor with its front bumper facing open space, well away from stairs and drop-offs.
Press the start button once and step back.
Watch the first few seconds: the vacuum drives forward a short way in a straight line, without turning or reversing.
procedure.source: Authored SymptomSketch demo procedure (not a manufacturer manual)

fixtures.name: Desk fan
fixtures.alt: A black desk fan with a round guard on a short stalk and a round base, standing on a glass table beside a small potted plant, with a plush toy cat sitting on the base.
fixtures.exampleIssue: The head swings to the left, stops, then snaps back to the right instead of sweeping smoothly.

procedure.title: Run the fan on low with the head sweeping side to side
steps: Stand the fan on a flat, stable surface with the guard facing open space and nothing touching the blades or the base.
Switch the fan on at its lowest speed, then turn on the side-to-side sweep if your fan has one.
Watch the head for a full sweep: it turns steadily to one side and then steadily back, without jerking, stopping or tilting.
procedure.source: Authored SymptomSketch demo procedure (not a manufacturer manual)

fixtures.name: Camera drone
fixtures.alt: A white quadcopter camera drone with landing legs and an underslung gimbal camera hovering just above a lake at dusk.
fixtures.exampleIssue: It lifts off, drifts sideways, then dips and levels out again.

procedure.title: Take off and hold a low hover in an open area
steps: Set the drone on a flat, level surface in a wide open area with no people, pets or obstacles within arm's reach of the propellers.
Power on the drone and the remote, then lift off gently to about eye height.
Release the controls and watch for a few seconds: the drone holds one spot in the air, level, without drifting sideways or bobbing up and down.
procedure.source: Authored SymptomSketch demo procedure (not a manufacturer manual)
